findings.title: Login-list invalidation uses organization-wrapped effective enabled state
findings.body: `original` is obtained through `getById`, which wraps organization-linked providers so that `isEnabled()` is false whenever the linked organization is disabled. `getLoginPredicate()` therefore treats both the old and updated provider as unavailable while an organization is disabled, even if an update changes a field that controls the underlying login query (for example `hideOnLogin` from true to false, or the reverse). The method then skips invalidation, although the delegate's `getForLogin` query filters the provider's stored enabled/hide/link/public fields rather than the organization wrapper's effective enabled state. This can leave the cached ID set missing or retaining that provider; after the organization is enabled again, callers continue to receive an incorrect login-provider list until an unrelated invalidation occurs. Determine eligibility for invalidation from the unwrapped/stored model fields (or otherwise invalidate when those query fields change), rather than calling the wrapper-sensitive predicate on `original`.
